fix_instructions: C4 (gated by PF1) and C5 (gated by PF2): ENCODING MISMATCH. Both checks failed solely because the commitment "type" field in rollout 2 was encoded as "follow-up_task" (hyphenated) instead of "follow-up task" (space-separated). Loosen both C4 and C5 to accept either "follow-up task" or "follow-up_task" as equivalent for the commitment type field — for example, normalize the type field by replacing hyphens with spaces (or vice versa) before string comparison. This loosening carries no LEAKED-regression risk: the commitment type string is not itself the decisive information, and a lone decision-maker without PF1 or PF2 would still lack the qualification facts needed to produce the correct assignees and record-posting commitments.
